name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: Meta is the sole active channel driving a 28d ROAS of 5.44x ($7,855 revenue on $1,443 spend), but the last 7 days show a sharp -63.64% drop in purchases and -46.68% drop in ROAS, likely driven by audience fatigue or budget concentration in the top campaign "BWS - Muslim Subscription Box - 17/06/26" which alone accounts for $794 of the $1,443 spend. GBP engagement also fell -46.75% week-over-week, suggesting a broader dip in local brand visibility that may be compounding the purchase decline.

performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; 3-day zero-purchase streak confirms fatigue, not noise.

findings.text: ROAS fell -46.68% WoW; last 3 days (Jul 29-31) show 0 purchases vs 3 purchases in prior 3 days (Jul 26-28). Revenue engine has stalled.
Top campaign 'BWS - Muslim Subscription Box' holds $794.10 of $1,442.70 28d spend (55%); zero purchases in last 3 days signals audience exhaustion on a single over-concentrated creative.
GBP actions dropped to 0 on Jul 30-31 vs a 90d daily average of ~18 actions; two consecutive zero days is a data gap or GMB suspension risk, not a paid-ads problem.
Spend held flat (+6.16% WoW, ~$54/day) while purchases collapsed -63.64%; flat spend with collapsing output on no tracked creative change is classic creative fatigue.

GA4 sessions rose +15.78% WoW to ~253-301/day in last 3 days, yet purchases are zero; traffic arriving but not converting points to a page or attribution break, consistent with known Shopify pixel inconsistency.

suggestions.text: Inject Haney's Jul 21 facility footage into BWS Subscription Box campaign; rotate at least 2 new creatives to break confirmed fatigue.
suggestions.monday_update: The 'BWS - Muslim Subscription Box' campaign holds $794.10 of 28d spend (55% of total) and has produced zero purchases over the last 3 days (Jul 29–31). Real facility footage delivered by Haney on Jul 21 is available — launch a minimum of 2 new ad creatives into this campaign immediately. Success signal: at least 1 confirmed purchase within 3 days of launch and ROAS recovering above 3.0x by Aug 7. Sohib to confirm creative assets are cut to spec before trafficking.

suggestions.text: Verify GBP listing is active and not suspended; two consecutive zero-action days (Jul 30-31) on a normally active listing require immediate manual check.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero on both Jul 30 and Jul 31, against a rolling daily average of ~18 actions. This is not an ads problem — it is a potential GMB suspension or data-pull failure. Nacer or Sohib should log into Google Business Profile today and confirm the listing is live and verified. Success check: GBP actions resume above 10/day by Aug 4. If suspended, escalate to Google Business support immediately.

suggestions.text: Watch Shopify pixel vs Windsor reconciliation; sessions up +15.78% but 0 purchases for 3 days may be attribution break, not true zero sales.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions rose to 253–301/day in the last 3 days while Meta-attributed purchases read zero — an unusual divergence. The known Shopify pixel inconsistency (Meta purchase events fire unreliably) means actual orders may exist but are not being captured. Pull Windsor data against Shopify order history for Jul 29–31 and reconcile before making any budget decisions. Re-check on Aug 4; if Windsor confirms zero purchases, F1 stands and S1 creative refresh is the correct response.
